SYNTHETIC COURSE EXAMPLE — NOT COLLECTED DATA
All people, organizations and papers below are invented.
P1: Researcher A at Organization X; Researcher B at Organization Y.
Title: Invented language-model study one.
Abstract: This invented paper studies language models.
Venue: ICML 2023 main conference. No citation in this example.
P2: Researcher A at Organization X; Researcher C at Organization Y.
Title: Invented language-model study two.
Abstract: This invented paper studies language models.
Venue: ICML 2023 main conference. Explicitly cites P1.
P3: Researcher D at Organization X; Researcher E at Organization Z.
Title: Invented language-model study three.
Abstract: This invented paper studies language models.
Venue: ICML 2023 main conference. Explicitly cites P1.
Taxonomy: NLP and language models is a leaf of Language and perception.
This is the miniature worked example from the plan, not the full taxonomy/corpus.
